visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a digital interface showing a first-person perspective in a white, minimalist hallway. A large white sign with Japanese text is mounted on the wall. In the bottom right corner, a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue hoodie, sits in a room with a PC and microphone, reacting to the screen. (2) The perspective moves into a brightly lit indoor pool area with large windows overlooking a sea. A 3D animated man with reddish hair and binoculars stands by the pool, and a woman in a red bikini is nearby. A colorful beach ball floats in the water. The lighting is bright and even. (3) The character interacts with various anomalies: a Shiba Inu dog on the pool deck suddenly turns into a mechanical robot cat. The camera zooms in on these changes. Later, an oversized man in white underwear appears, and a game interface prompt shows the player taking photos. (4) The perspective shifts to a ceiling where a character is seen hanging upside down. The reactor in the inset screen shows expressions of shock and laughter, covering her mouth and gesturing with her hands towards the camera. The background of the reactor is a dimly lit room with shelving and computer equipment.
